zh: 并非所有幸福都能长久，随着时光流逝……

A carefree life where I’m in charge
is much more fitting to me, right?
zh:
由我做主的自在日子
才更适合我，对吧？

zh: 于是，霍勒与伊莉丝在基弗贝格村里共度时光。

enUS: As both grew closer so did their love for one another.
zh: 两人越靠越近，彼此的爱也日渐深厚。

enUS:
By the brilliant light that engulfs visions
I stow so deep in my bosom?
zh:
被那吞没愿景的璀璨之光
我深藏心底的一切又当如何？

enUS:
Come offer our prayers to the court of stars
above — let us offer them.
zh:
向天上的星之法庭献上祈祷吧
——让我们一同祷告。

enUS: Cradled inside a rope basket was a cheerful baby girl.
zh: 绳篮里躺着一个咯咯笑的婴孩。

zh: 被熊熊烈焰熏黑、沉入灰烬

enUS:
Engraving such a pure name,
the true moniker of your soul
zh:
将如此纯净的名字铭刻，
那是你灵魂真正的名讳

enUS:
Even if just once, let me shine
brighter than anyone else.
zh:
哪怕只有一次，让我比任何人
都更加耀眼。

enUS:
Every year, no matter by whom
or how many times I was adorned
zh:
年复一年，无论被谁
装点过多少次

enUS: Hey, look at me more, more
zh: 喂，再多看我一眼，再多一点

enUS: Hey, look at me…
zh: 喂，看看我啊……

enUS: I’m done with this thankless struggle!\nNo more being bossed around!
zh: 我受够了这种徒劳的挣扎！\n再也不任人摆布了！

enUS: I’ve been but following the dreams I have…
zh: 我一直只是在追随自己的梦……

enUS: LOOK AT ME, LOOK AT ME
zh: 看着我，看着我

enUS: Led by the kismet passed down unto me
zh: 循着传承予我的宿命

enUS:
Let us engrave the Rondo
of the Six Stars and dance...
zh:
让我们刻下六星回旋曲
起舞吧……

enUS: Like a rose who couldn’t bloom on her own, \nI was overshadowed.
zh: 如一朵无法独自绽放的玫瑰，\n我被掩去光芒。

enUS: Make everyone look at me
zh: 让所有人都看着我

enUS: Mine was a birth midst the blackest sky
zh: 我生于最漆黑的夜空之下

zh: 哪怕它们预示的只是无可逃避的宿命。”

zh: 噢，指引我梦境的绯红啊，\n就让我任性一次吧？

zh: 从前，在一处遥远山谷的深处，

enUS: So did Holle’s…
zh: 霍勒的……也是如此。

enUS:
Step by step by step,
I keep on this relentless march,
zh:
一步，一步，一步，
我不停走下去，

enUS:
Walking on, to the rhythm of the song
heralded to me by the bell of the heavenly oracle.
zh:
前行，合着那首歌的节拍
那是天国神谕之钟为我昭示的歌。

enUS: When all of a sudden, she heard a loud cry in the distance.
zh: 忽然之间，她听见远处传来一声啼哭。

enUS:
Will I be able to reach the end of this
journey whose final act is heralded
zh:
我能否走到这旅程的终点
那终幕已被昭示

enUS: an elderly woman ventured deep into the woods in search for mushrooms.
zh: 一位老妪深入林中，寻找蘑菇。

enUS: deep within my heart,
zh: 深藏于我心，

enUS: look at me
zh: 看着我

enUS: the poverty never ended.
zh: 贫穷从未终结。

enUS: “Don’t cry, my love.”
zh: “别哭，我的爱人。”

enUS: “From now on, it’s Miss Elise to you!”
zh: “从今往后，你得叫我伊莉丝小姐！”

enUS: “Fufufu ♪ Well done, Elise!”
zh: “呵呵呵♪ 做得好，伊莉丝！”

enUS: “I love you, Elise.”
zh: “我爱你，伊莉丝。”

enUS: “I’ll do whatever it takes, granny!”
zh: “奶奶，我什么都愿意做！”

enUS: “I’ll name you… Elise!”
zh: “我就叫你……伊莉丝！”

enUS: “I’ll take care of you!”
zh: “我会好好照顾你的！”

enUS: “Look, granny! Look!”
zh: “奶奶，你看！快看！”

enUS: “My goodness!”
zh: “天哪！”

enUS: “No more!”
zh: “够了！”

enUS:
“Oh, beacon which guides me
Bestow upon me visions anew...
zh:
“噢，指引我的灯塔啊
请赐予我新的幻象……

enUS: “Oh, my! What do I do?”
zh: “哎呀！我该怎么办？”

enUS: “Thank you for granting my only wish...”
zh: “谢谢你实现了我唯一的愿望……”

enUS: “Worry not, my dear.”
zh: “别担心，亲爱的。”

enUS: “You’ve always said you wanted it. I’m sure you’ll cherish it. Fufufu ♪”
zh: “你一直说想要它。我肯定你会好好珍惜的。呵呵呵♪”
